project.purpose: Expose four existing independently consumer-tested composition semantics as R2.1 responsibilities; not new verification machinery or a second owner.

nodes.label: CircuitManifestContract
nodes.responsibility: Compile one bounded typed Composition circuit manifest and reject illegal port/producer/dependency wiring, without executing stages.
nodes.authority: Composition source contract (Git); execution/consumer truth stays with Runtime, Host, Gateway and domain systems
inputs: task-local manifest with stages, typed ports, edges, method/capability bindings, gate requirements
outputs: immutable source-bound compiled circuit projection, stable manifest digest and deterministic DAG stage ordering
nodes.behavioralContract: On admitted manifest, all edge endpoints are declared, one producer feeds each input, cross-stage gate contracts respect owner and prerequisite boundaries, cycles are rejected; compilation neither executes stages nor grants authority.
acceptance: Valid manifest compiles deterministically; dangling ports, multiple producers, same-owner cross-boundary gates, cyclic or missing dependencies fail closed.
nodes.replacementCondition: Replace only with a manifest compiler preserving the same consumer-visible accepted inputs, rejections, ordering, and digest identity.

nodes.label: CompositionGateStanding
nodes.responsibility: Derive bounded cross-boundary composition-gate standing from verifier-supplied records scoped to one compiled circuit, without minting verifier/domain facts.
nodes.authority: Composition source contract (Git); execution/consumer truth stays with Runtime, Host, Gateway and domain systems
inputs: C01 manifest and digest-bound compiled circuit
declared required gate results with verifier owner, scope and standing
outputs: COMPOSITION_GATES_SATISFIED | OPEN | UNSATISFIED projection, identified unresolved/unknown gates
nodes.behavioralContract: Reject wrong circuit, wrong manifest digest, wrong verifier scope and duplicates. Empty required gates, missing/UNKNOWN required gates or unresolved assumptions cannot yield mechanical closure. Closure never equals domain success.
acceptance: Mismatched/stale gate results fail; unknown and missing required gates keep the gate open; domainAcceptanceEstablished is always false.
nodes.replacementCondition: Any replacement must preserve fail-closed scoped evidence and distinguish mechanical closure from domain acceptance.

nodes.label: InterfaceCompatibilityAndCurrentness
nodes.responsibility: Compare a consumer's accepted interface contract to one exact source observation; keep compatibility, currentness, evidence admissibility independent.
nodes.authority: Composition source contract (Git); execution/consumer truth stays with Runtime, Host, Gateway and domain systems
inputs: source-qualified interface observation and declared accepted alternate digests
outputs: interface compatibility, source/currentness standing, evidence admissibility, scoped result digest
nodes.behavioralContract: Exact digest or explicitly accepted alternate is not automatic behavioral refinement. Missing live authority version is UNKNOWN; historical source is inadmissible; same circuit and exact source scope are required.
acceptance: An unknown authority version cannot become current; a stale/mismatched observation is not admitted; a declared compatible interface never establishes domain acceptance.
nodes.replacementCondition: Candidate evaluator must preserve independent compatibility/currentness/admissibility judgments, without owner-version fabrication.

nodes.label: VerificationObligationImpact
nodes.responsibility: Compile named circuit-gate proof obligations and conservatively select task-local rechecks for declared changed, retired, contract/relation-mutated or unknown dependencies.
nodes.authority: Composition source contract (Git); execution/consumer truth stays with Runtime, Host, Gateway and domain systems
inputs: caller-provided authority refs, obligation dependencies, changed and unknown source/contract refs; optional previous graph
outputs: digest-bound obligation set; RECHECK_REQUIRED/UNKNOWN/REUSE_CANDIDATE standings; unindexed changes
nodes.behavioralContract: An unindexed or unknown relation cannot silently establish proof validity. Caller declarations are not owner-certified dependency closure; basis digest and REUSE_CANDIDATE never constitute proof acceptance or admissible reuse.
acceptance: Changing/deleting an obligation, dependency relation, or property creates a conservative recheck/unknown; projection preserves proofReuseAdmissible=false and proofAcceptanceEstablished=false.
nodes.replacementCondition: Alternative selector must conservatively cover declared changes and unknowns, bind exact owner-certified readset before any positive proof-reuse claim.

edges.label: Gate standing consumes exact compiled circuit and manifest digest
Compatibility evaluator uses canonical circuit/source identity and schema routines
Obligation compiler consumes manifest compilation and gate scopes
Both concern required gate identities; projection outputs do not themselves certify one another

slices.objective: Native Composition circuit, gate, interface and obligation responsibilities have explicit consumer-visible R2.1 roles and exact evidence; no installed/other-Owner correctness upgrade.
acceptance: All four code anchors resolve to immutable SourceCut Git blobs and have native consumer tests.
Native scoped tests pass on the candidate source tree.
Root graph reflects the new nodes and relations without reinterpreting older Owner R2/R3 plans.
slices.nextAction: Independently qualify dynamic and cross-owner readset/installed evidence before upgrading current proof reuse.

gaps: Native tests are exact local CODE evidence, not execution-provider or installed evidence.
The declared evidence and consumer paths do not establish dynamic consumer closure.
Retire/unify any stale successor-only responsibilities after negative consumer falsification rather than duplicating them.
doNotOwn: repository planning truth, generic LEGO registry, domain success, executable permission, verifier proof truth
